_comment: Model manifest for LTX-2.3 V2V / IC-LoRA support. Consumed by scripts/models/install_models.sh --version 23. Each entry downloads a single file from a Hugging Face repo into models/<dest>/<filename>. Sets marked "gated": true require HF_TOKEN and clicking 'Agree and Access' on the repo page at least once.

models.desc: Gemma 3 12B text encoder (fp4 mixed, smallest official variant)
LTX-2.3 22B dev checkpoint, fp8 quantized (video+audio VAE bundled) - needs ~24GB VRAM. NOTE: fp8 not yet available on HF; use checkpoint_bf16 or gguf_distilled_q4 instead.
LTX-2.3 22B dev checkpoint, full BF16 - needs 32GB+ VRAM
Distilled speed-up LoRA (8-step sampling instead of ~30)
LTX-2.3 dev GGUF Q4_K_M - fits ~12GB VRAM with ComfyUI-GGUF's Unet Loader (GGUF) node
LTX-2.3 dev GGUF Q8_0 - higher quality, needs ~20GB VRAM
LTX-2.3 distilled GGUF Q4_K_M - fastest, fits ~8-12GB VRAM
LTX-2.3 video VAE (bf16) - only needed if not using a bundled checkpoint/GGUF
LTX-2.3 audio VAE (bf16) - only needed if not using a bundled checkpoint/GGUF
IC-LoRA: character/prop consistency from a reference sheet image
IC-LoRA: colorize grayscale/B&W video (official Lightricks version)
IC-LoRA: colorize grayscale/B&W video (community alt, ungated)
IC-LoRA: relight daytime video to night
IC-LoRA: remove compression artifacts / restore low-bitrate video
IC-LoRA: sharpen out-of-focus / blurry video
IC-LoRA: add realistic moving water VFX to a scene
IC-LoRA: video inpainting and outpainting
IC-LoRA: remove facial hair while preserving identity/motion (demo IC-LoRA)
IC-LoRA: 16-bit HDR generation / SDR-to-HDR conversion
EXPERIMENTAL: general post-processing detail/texture enhancer. Trained on LTX-2 19b, not confirmed compatible with LTX-2.3 22b - test before relying on it.
Audio-reactive LoRA for music-visualizer / beat-synced generations (fal.ai, v2)
ID-LoRA for talking-head/identity consistency (CelebV-HQ trained)
ID-LoRA for talking-head/identity consistency (TalkVid trained)

EXPERIMENTAL: Edit Anything v1.1 - prompt-only multitask video editing (Add/Remove/Replace/Style, ~300 style names). Standalone standard LoRA, no companion node/module needed - loads through any ComfyUI LoRA loader. Author explicitly labels these research artifacts, not production-ready. See docs/LTX_2.3_WORKFLOW_ENHANCEMENTS.md for prompting rules (strict caption-shape requirements per task type).

EXPERIMENTAL: Edit Anything v0.1 motion-transfer LoRA (rank 128) - swap the first frame of a guide video then copy its motion onto the new subject. Standalone standard LoRA. Fails on hard scene cuts and fast motion - see setup doc.

EXPERIMENTAL: Edit Anything Ref V2V (reference-image add/replace), 4-extras build, standard LoRA half. MUST be loaded together with editanything_refv2v_module (same build) - do not mix with the 2-extras pair. Requires ComfyUI-BFSNodes custom node to consume the module sidecar.

EXPERIMENTAL: Edit Anything Ref V2V (reference-image add/replace), 4-extras build, module sidecar half. Load via ComfyUI-BFSNodes' LTXVEditAnythingModuleLoader, paired with editanything_refv2v_standard from the same build.

VBVR (Video Reasoning) I2V LoRA - trained on ~1M physics/causal/spatial reasoning videos (object trajectories, collisions, multi-object interaction). Community-reported to help motion realism and fine motion (e.g. hair) where base LTX-2.3 stays static. Official ComfyUI-converted file from LiconStudio; a diffsynth-format original and an earlier weaker ComfyUI port (siraxe) also circulate - this is the one reported strongest in community testing.

OmniNFT RL-tuned quality LoRA (better AV sync, audio quality, prompt adherence). Use strength 2.0 in ComfyUI (not 1.0) to match the original alpha=64/rank=32 training config. NOTE: source repo (FastVideo/zghhui) is marked 'research use only' - confirm licensing fits your use case before deploying commercially.
2x latent spatial upscaler for LTX-2.3

IC-LoRA: Union Control - combines depth + edge (canny) + human pose guidance into a single unified LoRA, operating on downsampled latents for speed. Use with the ICLoRA Union Control example workflow (LTX-2.3_ICLoRA_Union_Control_Distilled.json).
TAE (tiny autoencoder) for LTX-2.3 - fast, lower-quality VAE decode used for real-time-ish previews while a generation is still sampling. Not a substitute for the full video_vae on final output.
